notes.title: New muscular update!
notes.content:
Hi there!
We have new update! KinnikuNeko has more and more well defined muscles every day!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Now you can pause and restart the "ParaPara" Minigame (thanks to Pazos64 for the suggestion).,
[*] Improved the "ParaPara" Minigame precision detection.,
[*] Some minor general and visual improvements.,
[*] Some minor bug fixing.
[/list]

Thank you all!

tags.feature: Now you can pause and restart the "ParaPara" Minigame (thanks to Pazos64 for the suggestion).

tags.bug: Some minor bug fixing.

notes.title: New update 1.0.3.burpees: General fixes and improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an error that makes KinnikuNeko don’t die in some situations, some of them causing an infinite fall state (Thank you nottsu for the report).
[*] Fixed an error that makes lifting difficult or even impossible smashing the button (Thank you to the people that report it).
[*] Fixed an error that cause the main menu can’t be navigated when the game lost focus in some specific states.
[*] The unicorns now doesn’t shoot their rainbow laser if the rider on top of them is dead.
[*] Fixed an error causing the unicorns damages other enemies or KinnikuNeko even if their are not shooting the rainbow laser.
[*] Fixed an error when in some specific situations if you crouch on top of a platform, KinnikuNeko doesn’t move with the platform.
[*] Fixed the behaviour in the platforms of the second stage in Atlantia. Now only can be activated with the switchs and not by character proximity.
[*] Changed the default mapping for the “para para minigame” in order to match the color buttons with the minigame colors.
[*] Added the full energy bar sound when reach the 100% in the second phase of the queen fight.
[*] Fixed some situations when the full energy bar sound is triggered withouth need.
[*] Fixed some situations when the full energy bar particle effect remains on screen even when the UI is hidden.
[*] Added a small cooldown between the soldiers helmet drop their activation to hit it in order to avoid sound saturation.
[*] Fixed the final gym alien animation being missaligned with the weight sometimes.
[*] Fixed a bug that makes the door in Atlantia close visually but you can pass trough it.
[*] Added a new fan-art.
[*] More minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]

Fixed an error when in some specific situations if you crouch on top of a platform, KinnikuNeko doesn’t move with the platform.
Fixed the behaviour in the platforms of the second stage in Atlantia. Now only can be activated with the switchs and not by character proximity.
Fixed some situations when the full energy bar sound is triggered withouth need.
Fixed some situations when the full energy bar particle effect remains on screen even when the UI is hidden.
Fixed the final gym alien animation being missaligned with the weight sometimes.
Fixed a bug that makes the door in Atlantia close visually but you can pass trough it.

notes.title: SUPER AWESOME UPDATE BURPEES EDITION!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
[h2]BIG NEWS AND MUSCLES![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077717/3571f07442bd01858772f93945117b8f5fc67b52.gif[/img]

I'm very happy to tell you that thanks to the support of the publisher [b]Mameshiba Games[/b], the game has undergone many changes for this new update, which will also be public on consoles ([i]Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox[/i]).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077717/e2bc9efe43669e48fdd501548c0d1716c1323a24.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]This update fixes some bugs[/b] that were still dragging before.
[*] [b]The artwork of all scenarios has been updated[/b] and some areas have been slightly changed.
[*] [b]Enemy intelligence and enemy feedback has been improved[/b]. For example the aliens in UFO now don't pass by when they shoot at you and the mole aliens give you a few moments to dodge them!
[/list]

[h1][b]FULL DUBBING ?![/b][/h1]

The game now has [b]FULL DUBBING in Japanese, English and Spanish![/b]
Even the NPCs are voiced!
It has also been subtitled in [b]9 languages: Japanese, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, German and Russian[/b].

[b]There are new achievements[/b] and some new secrets.
I really hope you enjoy this great update!
[b][h1]Thank you very much for playing![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077717/d392599553c3b4dc816ec6bfea75b00b699ee92b.png[/img]

notes.title: SUPER AWESOME UPDATE!!!
notes.content:
SUPER AWESOME UPDATE!
This is the big update of KinnikuNeko.
Thanks to "Mameshiba Games" as publisher, the game now features:
- Full dubbing (including NPCs) in Japanese, English and Spanish!!!
- Redesigned scenarios with new artwork.
- Improvement in some cinematics.
- Languages: English, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, German.
- Fixed the most important bugs

notes.title: Some Updates 1.13
notes.content:
- Atlantia, Forest and Crazy Sunset stages fixed bug that passes through wall.
- Sudden camera movements have been reduced.
- "Default button" on Settings doesn't get stuck.
- "Back" button call from key/button to leave the menus.
- Separate volume sliders for music, sound and voices have been added.
- You can change the interface buttons and language in real time.
- Feedback more visible in the Sprint bar.
- The enemy "Mole" allows a little more time to dodge.
- High and Low pass filter applied to all sounds.
- Solved the "Pause" during the credits.

*The next update will include rebind the keyboard buttons and save Cloud.
